title: Bank Imaging Administrator
description:
Imaging Administrator Spire Leicester Oadby Bank Ad-Hoc Shifts Competitive Hourly Rate Weekly Pay

Spire Leicester Hospital are currently recruiting an Imaging Administrator to join their Admin department on a bank basis.

This is a flexible bank role, working on an "as and when required" basis to support staffing levels during busy periods and provide cover during periods of annual leave and absence.

The Role

As an Imaging Administrator, you'll provide essential administrative support to our multidisciplinary radiology team by:
- Managing and coordinating radiology appointments in line with departmental procedures.
- Contacting patients to arrange bookings and supporting them throughout their journey.
- Liaising with consultants, clinicians and hospital departments to ensure efficient service delivery.
- Processing radiology reports and ensuring timely distribution to the relevant recipients.
- Providing pricing information and estimates for self-pay patients.
- Maintaining accurate patient records across hospital and radiology information systems.
- Collecting, collating and reporting activity data, including NHS and BUPA reporting requirements.
- Supporting general departmental administration including filing, document management and correspondence.
- Ensuring compliance with data protection, confidentiality and information governance standards.
- Contributing to quality improvement initiatives and supporting the training and induction of new colleagues.

What We're Looking For
- Strong administrative and organisational skills.
- Excellent attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate records.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Excellent keyboard and IT skills.
- The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Benefits:

We offer employed colleagues a competitive salary as well as a comprehensive benefits package which includes but is not limited to:
- Bank colleagues are paid weekly
- We offer competitive rates to our bank colleagues who work on a flexible basis, often to cover busy periods, sickness, or annual leave
- Save an average of 50 per month with our free onsite car park
- Access to Spire Healthcare pension
- Access to Blue Light Card discounts
- Smartspending discounts (in addition to Blue Light discounts) via 'Spire for You'
- Wellbeing Centre access via 'Spire for You'
- Free uniform
- Free DBS
- Full induction, including mandatory training updates
- Opportunities for further training and progression into permanent posts
- Knowledge, support and guidance through your recruitment journey from Spire's specialist Resourcing Team

Our Values:

We are extremely proud of our heritage in private healthcare and of our values as an organisation:
- Driving clinical excellence
- Doing the right thing
- Caring is our passion.
- Keeping it simple
- Delivering on our promises
- Succeeding and celebrating together

We commit to our employees' well-being through work life balance, on-going development, support and reward.

Spire Healthcare is a leading independent healthcare group in the United Kingdom, running 38 hospitals and over 50 clinics across England, Wales and Scotland. It provides diagnostics, inpatient, day case and outpatient care, operates a network of private GPs and provides workplace health services to over 800 corporate clients. It also delivers a range of private and NHS mental health, musculoskeletal and dermatological services.

Spire Healthcare are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture for all. Our people are our difference, it's their dedication, warmth and pursuit of excellence that sets Spire Healthcare apart.

We re offering a competitive salary based on experience, a permanent position with Monday Friday working hours, and the opportunity to develop your skills within an established and growing LPCB-certified fire protection company. You ll receive training and ongoing development, with the opportunity to progress within the business, working as part of a friendly and supportive team in a varied role within the fire protection industry. - Assist the Service Team Lead with scheduling and coordinating engineers and installation teams, organising service, maintenance and installation appointments, while managing daily diaries and updating schedules for field engineers
- Act as the first point of contact for incoming office calls and emails, maintaining a professional and friendly approach while providing a high level of customer service to customers and contractors
- Prepare documentation using Microsoft Office, update digital company systems and maintain accurate records for compliance purposes, including tracking quotes through online digital platforms and processing job sheets, timesheets and service reports
- Assist with invoicing and day-to-day administrative tasks for the management team, while acting as an operational systems champion to support compliance with internal QA systems and procedures and developing and maintaining the company s social media presence in line with Complii Group guidelines

Can you show experience in some of these areas:
- Are you highly organised with excellent attention to detail, able to manage multiple tasks, changing priorities and busy schedules while remaining calm and organised?
- Are you confident communicating with customers and contractors, with a professional, friendly and approachable manner and a strong commitment to customer service?
- Are you computer literate and confident using Microsoft Office and digital systems, with the ability to maintain accurate records and learn new systems quickly?
- Are you reliable, able to work independently and a good problem solver with a practical, proactive and can-do attitude?

Do you have previous experience in scheduling, administration, construction, engineering, facilities management or the fire protection industry? This would be advantageous but is not essential for the right candidate.

Introducing our organisation:
